title: Uplink — Software for Agents
excerpt: End-to-end infrastructure for coding agents. Install from npm, then share localhost, deploy an app, and attach a domain without a dashboard or browser handoff.
content_html:
Agent based web management

One npm package. No dashboard. No browser handoff. Your agent can share localhost, deploy the app, and attach its domain from the shell it already has.
